advancements.lacuna.borrowed_seconds.des: Feed a Chronal Shard to a Chrono Hourglass and watch time hurry around it.
advancements.lacuna.defeat_reflection.de: Step on the ring at the heart of a Mirror Labyrinth and defeat your own Reflection.
advancements.lacuna.every_relic.descript: Hold each of the fifteen relics at least once. The Almanac says where they hide.
advancements.lacuna.every_relic.title: Curator of the Forgotten
advancements.lacuna.exilite.description: Dig up Exilite Debris, hidden in the stone deep below the Forgotten Land (diamond pickaxe).
advancements.lacuna.exilite.title: The Totem's Own Stone
advancements.lacuna.find_relic.descripti: Find a relic. No smith can make one: search Sunken Bell Towers, treasure and Mirror Hoards, or pay the Last Merchant.
advancements.lacuna.find_relic.title: Never Forged
advancements.lacuna.forge_eclipser.descr: Claim the Eclipser, a relic no smith can forge.
advancements.lacuna.forge_eclipser.title: Blade of the Eclipse
advancements.lacuna.in_the_bag.descripti: Stuff a creature into a Comically Large Bag.
advancements.lacuna.in_the_bag.title: It's in the Bag
advancements.lacuna.its_a_wrap.descripti: Mummify a creature with Starlace Bandages.
advancements.lacuna.its_a_wrap.title: It's a Wrap
advancements.lacuna.its_alive.descriptio: Wake a dropped item with the Wand of Quickening and let it fight beside you.
advancements.lacuna.its_alive.title: It's Alive!
advancements.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence: Obtain a Lacunar Quintessence, the essence every totem is made from.
advancements.lacuna.last_merchant.descri: Trade with the Last Merchant. He turns up by day now and then, and takes nothing but rubies.
advancements.lacuna.last_merchant.title: Rubies Only
advancements.lacuna.link_pearl.descripti: Split a Fractured Pearl into its linked shards.
advancements.lacuna.link_pearl.title: Two Halves
advancements.lacuna.mine_ruby.descriptio: Mine a ruby: the ore hides deep, from Y 16 down, like diamonds.
advancements.lacuna.mine_ruby.title: A Gem the Mountains Cried
advancements.lacuna.mirror_labyrinth.des: Walk into a Mirror Labyrinth, somewhere in the Forgotten Land.
advancements.lacuna.moth_to_a_flame.desc: Collect Silk Dust from a Lantern Moth: they flutter around bright light on forest and swamp nights.
advancements.lacuna.nightforged.descript: Forge an Umbral Steel tool, a ruby set in its grip: it digs faster where it is dark.
advancements.lacuna.nightforged.title: Nightforged
advancements.lacuna.obelisk.description: Read an Obelisk of Unreadable Names, a black pillar standing alone in the wilds.
advancements.lacuna.obelisk.title: Seven Brothers, No Names
advancements.lacuna.open_portal.descript: Light a Forgotten Portal: eight frames around a 2×2 opening, touched with the totem.
advancements.lacuna.open_portal.title: The Way Stays Open
advancements.lacuna.ore_song.description: Ring a Sunken Bell and see the ores around it answer.
advancements.lacuna.ore_song.title: Ore Song
advancements.lacuna.possession.descripti: Possess a creature while shadow walking after an Eclipser dash.
advancements.lacuna.possession.title: Through Another's Eyes
advancements.lacuna.root.description: Pick up the Lacuna Almanac, or find a ruby: the world remembers more than it shows.
advancements.lacuna.root.title: Lacuna
advancements.lacuna.shooting_star.descri: See a star fall from the clear night sky on its own.
advancements.lacuna.shooting_star.title: Shooting Star
advancements.lacuna.sunken_bell_tower.de: Find a Sunken Bell Tower on the ocean floor.
advancements.lacuna.survive_banishment.d: Come back from the Forgotten Land.
advancements.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.d: Craft a Totem of Banishing: a Lacunar Quintessence on a Totem of Undying, with rubies and gold.
advancements.lacuna.triangle_of_instant_: Turn a creature to dust with the Ember Triangle.
advancements.lacuna.umbral_steel.descrip: Smelt an Umbral Steel ingot from the dark ore that lies below Y 0.
advancements.lacuna.umbral_steel.title: Heavier in the Dark
advancements.lacuna.village_friend.descr: Become Friendly with a village: trade, defend it, ring its bell at dawn.
advancements.lacuna.village_friend.title: A Friend of the Village
advancements.lacuna.wayfarer.description: Craft a Wayfarer's Chart, a map that remembers the Overworld wherever you are.
advancements.lacuna.wayfarer.title: Wayfarer
advancements.lacuna.which_one_is_real.de: Hide among copies of yourself with a Totem of Confusion.
advancements.lacuna.wish_upon_a_star.des: Call a falling star down with the Starcaller Trumpet.
advancements.lacuna.zenithite.descriptio: Mine zenithite on the floating islands of the Inverted Falls.
advancements.lacuna.zenithite.title: Where Waterfalls Run Upward
almanac.lacuna.about_relics.text:
Relics are Lacuna's special weapons and gadgets, and **no smith can forge them**: they are found, each in at least two places.
- Every Mirror Hoard holds one.
- Sunken Bell Towers, ruin caches and village mints hide a few.
- Vanilla bosses and treasure keep the ones that suit them.
- The Last Merchant brings two at random to every visit, for rubies.
They wear out and are mended at an anvil with their own material.
almanac.lacuna.about_relics.where: Each relic's page lists its sources with their chances, per chest or per kill (+Looting: +1% per level).
almanac.lacuna.chronal_shard.text: It ticks when nobody listens. It runs the Chrono Hourglass (60 seconds of sand each) and, set into the Chronoshard Pocket Watch, shortens its cooldown.
almanac.lacuna.chronal_shard.where: Buried watches in the Clockwork Dunes (1-2 each); husks 4% (player kills, +Looting); ruin caches, bell towers, hoards and obelisks; the Last Merchant (6 rubies) and the Scholars' Guild (8 coins).
almanac.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.text:
Every grain is a borrowed second. Feed this two-block hourglass Chronal Shards: 60 seconds of sand each, up to 10 minutes (sneak to pour the whole stack). While the sand runs, everything within 4 blocks lives **four times faster**: furnaces, crops, saplings, young animals. Water and lava flow twice as fast, and players there heal twice as fast.
A redstone signal holds the sand; a comparator reads the time left. Redstone timing, spawners and portals are never sped up.
almanac.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.where: Crafted: 4 gold ingots, 2 chronal shards, 2 glass and sand (GCG / #S# / GCG).
It ticks a little behind the world. Anywhere in your inventory it remembers a moment every two minutes (the last three). Use it to **rewind** to the newest moment at least 20 seconds old: your place, your health (if it was higher), your hunger; fire and freshly caught harmful effects are gone. It never crosses dimensions.
Chronal Shards set in from the other hand (up to 5) shorten its cooldown from 5 to 2½ minutes. Mend it with Umbral Steel ingots.
Mirror Hoards 9% · Sunken Bell Towers 4% · village mints 3% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 32 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.cinderfrost_flats.text: The cold edge of the land, where ash falls like snow and keeps your **footprints** for a while. Still ponds are capped with **Clear Ice**, so the drowned ruins below stay in view. Rare, bare Cindervine spires; nothing hostile spawns.
almanac.lacuna.cinderfrost_flats.where: The coldest stretches of the Forgotten Land. Ashen Snow drops itself; Clear Ice needs Silk Touch.
almanac.lacuna.cindervine.text: Charcoal-black wood split by ember-orange cracks that glow faintly. It never burns, yet its planks are good fuel; its leaves smoulder and drop Ember. A complete wood family: planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors, trapdoors, buttons and pressure plates.
almanac.lacuna.cindervine.where: Savannas, badlands and windswept hills; bare spires in the Cinderfrost Flats. Saplings from the leaves.
almanac.lacuna.civic_villages.text:
Villages remember how you treat them. Each one keeps your **reputation**, two laws, a council that sets a weekly policy and a coin of its own, and newly generated villages grow a civic square with a village hall, a mint, a guild hall and a schoolhouse.
Three new villagers find work there: the **Coiner**, the **Magistrate** and the **Guildmaster**.
almanac.lacuna.civic_villages.where: Every vanilla village; the civic square only in newly generated ones. A Village Ledger can found one anywhere.
almanac.lacuna.clockwork_decoy.text: Throw it: it unfolds into a brass mannequin, and every monster within 16 blocks that was after you (or after nothing at all) chases it instead for 15 seconds. Piglins, hoglins and wardens are not fooled.
almanac.lacuna.clockwork_decoy.where: Crafted (shapeless): 3 Clockwork Gears, a redstone dust and a white wool.
almanac.lacuna.clockwork_dunes.text: Hot, dry sand where time runs slow: crops grow at half speed. Half-buried **pocket watches** still tick in the dunes; dig them up for 1-2 Chronal Shards each. Rusted gears, dead bushes, rabbits and a few Echo Birches.
almanac.lacuna.clockwork_dunes.where: The hot, dry stretches of the Forgotten Land. Silk Touch keeps a Buried Watch whole.
almanac.lacuna.clockwork_gear.text: Still turning, a little. Three make a Clockwork Decoy, and one goes into every Repair Kit.
almanac.lacuna.comically_large_bag.text:
Bigger on the outside. Mostly. Empty, use it on a creature, a minecart, a boat or an armour stand to stuff it inside; sneak + use on a block to bag it, contents and all. Full, use it on a block face to let it out exactly as it went in: the very same creature, chest or furnace.
With PvP on, it carries off a player for 15 seconds. Bosses, two-block blocks and too much nested loot won't fit, and a full bag cannot be destroyed.
almanac.lacuna.comically_large_bag.where: Crafted: 2 string, 5 leather, an ender pearl and a lead (SLS / LPL / LCL). Also 2% of village mint strongboxes.
almanac.lacuna.common_creatures.text:
A few common creatures carry Lacuna's materials:
- **Spiders and cave spiders:** an Umbral Steel Nugget, 5%.
- **Husks:** 0-2 Clockwork Gears, a Chronal Shard 4%.
- **Pillagers:** 0-1 Clockwork Gear.
- **Lantern Moths:** 0-2 Silk Dust.
The rare drops need a player kill; Looting helps all of them.
almanac.lacuna.common_creatures.where: Spiders everywhere after dark, husks in deserts, pillagers at outposts and raids.
almanac.lacuna.council.text:
Every seven days at dawn the council meets and sets a policy for the week, swayed by how well-liked its visitors were:
- **Free Market:** villager prices -10%.
- **Austerity:** prices +10%.
- **Festival:** reputation gains doubled, fireworks over the square.
- **Martial Law:** golems hit 50% harder, laws bite twice as fast.
The Council Table shows the village's mood and the odds of each policy.
almanac.lacuna.council.where: The Council Table stands in the village hall. Crafted: 3 carpets over 3 wooden slabs over a log (CCC / SSS / .L.).
almanac.lacuna.court.text: Fallen out with a village? At the **Judge's Bench** you can pay your way back: each village coin restores 5 reputation, up to 0 (the rest you earn with good deeds). The court hears you once every three days. A **Magistrate** works there and trades paper, books and name tags for coins.
almanac.lacuna.court.where: In the village hall. Judge's Bench: wooden slabs and a book over planks (SBS / PPP / P.P).
almanac.lacuna.crystal_willow.text: Translucent, pale green wood that glows softly, glassy leaves and hanging strands that sway beneath them. Its leaves drop Crystal Willow Shards. A complete wood family.
almanac.lacuna.crystal_willow.where: Cherry groves and meadows (rare); the floating islands and the ground of the Inverted Falls.
almanac.lacuna.crystal_willow_shard.text: Glassy splinters of the Crystal Willow. Four of them make a block of plain glass, no furnace needed.
almanac.lacuna.crystal_willow_shard.wher: Crystal Willow leaves drop them 5% of the time.
almanac.lacuna.divine_glass.text: Glass still warm with old light. Four shards make a block of **Divine Glass**: it glows softly and is a window into the stone. Look through it from close by and the stone behind falls away: only ores, chests, spawners and creatures remain. Six blocks make sixteen panes. Shards also mend the Magnifying Glass and the Mirror.
almanac.lacuna.divine_glass.where: Divine glass clusters grow only in the Forgotten Land (1 shard, +Fortune; Silk Touch keeps the cluster). Also ruin caches, bell towers, hoards and obelisks, the Last Merchant (4 rubies) and the Gemcutters' Guild (5 coins).
almanac.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.t:
Sunlight remembers where it was told to go. Hold use to focus a **burning beam** up to 24 blocks: 12 damage per second, setting creatures alight, kindling wood, melting snow and ice, priming TNT. At night it turns white and half as strong; underwater, blue, weaker and shorter. In the Forgotten Land it is always day.
Each Divine Glass Shard mends a minute of beam at an anvil.
almanac.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.w: Mirror Hoards 9% · desert pyramids 8% · village mints 3% · ruin caches 0.6% · the Last Merchant, 32 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.echo_birch.text: Pale ivory bark traced with faint blue runes; chopping it chimes. Plant two saplings within 4 blocks of each other and they grow together, joined by a bridge of leaves. A complete wood family.
almanac.lacuna.echo_birch.where: Birch forests; groves in the Forgotten Plains, a few trees in the Clockwork Dunes.
almanac.lacuna.echo_dagger.text: Every cut happens twice: half a second after each hit, its **echo** strikes again for 60% of the damage. Light and quick (3 damage, 2.6 attacks per second). Mend it with zenithite shards.
almanac.lacuna.echo_dagger.where: The Warden 33% (+Looting) · Mirror Hoards 9% · ancient city chests 4% · the Last Merchant, 40 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.echo_fragment.text: A memory that refused to fade. Each Echo called by the Whisperbone Flute leaves one behind as it fades, and each mends the flute by 20 uses at an anvil.
almanac.lacuna.echo_fragment.where: The Echoes of the Whisperbone Flute; Mirror Hoards.
almanac.lacuna.eclipser.text:
Where it cuts, the light forgets to return. Each hit charges the blade (+10%, shown above the hotbar); taking damage empties it. At 20% or more, use it to **dash** up to 14 blocks: everything along the way takes 15.6 to 30 damage and is flung aside, and you end in a **Shadow Walk** of 3 to 6 seconds.
8 damage, 20 s cooldown on the dash; mend it with Umbral Steel ingots.
almanac.lacuna.eclipser.where: Mirror Hoards 10% · ancient city chests 2% · ruin caches 0.3% · the Last Merchant, 64 rubies + 2 ruby blocks.
almanac.lacuna.ember.text: Burns for a very long time: one Ember smelts eight items. It also mends the Ember Triangle, 4 uses each.
almanac.lacuna.ember.where: Cindervine leaves drop it 5% of the time; the Last Merchant sells 4 for a ruby.
almanac.lacuna.ember_triangle.text:
Three embers that swore never to go out. Use it to release a **Thermal Wave** 10 blocks around you: hostile creatures, and anything hunting you, are pulverized on the spot. Bosses only take 30 damage. You, your pets, villagers, golems and peaceful animals are spared; other players only with PvP.
16 uses, 60 s cooldown; each Ember mends 4 uses at an anvil.
almanac.lacuna.ember_triangle.where: Bastion treasure 12% · Mirror Hoards 6% · ruin caches 0.3% · the Last Merchant, 64 rubies + 2 ruby blocks.
almanac.lacuna.exilite.text: The buried stone the Totem of Banishing was carved from. Smelt the debris into a shard; 4 shards and 4 gold ingots make an **Exilite Ingot**, which never burns and pays a beacon. One ingot between two crying obsidian makes two Forgotten Portal Frames: a way home built from the land itself. Nine ingots make a Block of Exilite.
almanac.lacuna.exilite.where: Exilite Debris, in small veins hidden in the stone below Y -8 of the Forgotten Land, about one every four chunks (diamond pickaxe; no explosion breaks it). Shards turn up in ruin caches too.
almanac.lacuna.exilite_stonework.text: A pale, lichen-flecked stone family: Exilite, Polished Exilite, Exilite Bricks with their stairs, slab and wall, and Chiseled Exilite, carved with the totem's open hand. Cut them at a crafting table or a stonecutter.
almanac.lacuna.exilite_stonework.where: One Exilite Shard in a ring of eight calcite gives eight Exilite.
almanac.lacuna.falling_stars.text: On clear Overworld nights (never the first) a star sometimes falls near a player, on open natural ground away from villages and buildings: roughly one night in three. A message says which way it fell, and the rock chimes softly. It leaves a Molten Star Rock to mine, and one star in five carries a **Lacunar Quintessence**, resting glowing at the impact.
almanac.lacuna.falling_stars.where: Look up on clear nights and follow the chime. Stars called with the Starcaller Trumpet never carry one.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_land.text:
A grey, foggy land caught in an endless afternoon. Every block here stands for **12** in the Overworld: a short walk there is a long way home.
You arrive banished, and a countdown (about six minutes, drifting from 4½ to 9) shows the Overworld spot you will return to. Until then the land keeps you: no beds, no ender pearls, no way out but its own. The totem lets you leave early.
Die here and your belongings fall in the Overworld under the same spot, glowing as **Unreadable Relics**: for ten minutes only you can pick them up.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_land.where: Use a Totem of Banishing, or step into a lit Forgotten Portal. A creature struck with the totem is sent here too.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_plains.text: The heart of the land: gentle grey hills crowded with ruins, groves of Echo Birch and, in about one chunk in forty, a patch of divine glass clusters. Spiders roam the fog.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_plains.where: Most of the Forgotten Land, between the four regions below.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_portal.text:
A way that stays open. Lay eight frames flat in a ring, two on each side with the corners left empty, around a 2×2 opening, then touch one with a Totem of Banishing: it costs one use, and the portal stays lit for good.
Step in to cross to the Forgotten Land, with the usual countdown and the 1:12 coordinates; a portal built there takes you home. Creatures pushed in are banished too.
almanac.lacuna.forgotten_portal.where: Frames: 4 rubies around a crying obsidian make one; an Exilite Ingot between two crying obsidian makes two.
almanac.lacuna.fractured_pearl.text:
Two halves that never stopped looking for each other. Use the pearl to split it into a linked pair:
- **Arrival Shard:** throw it; where it lands it anchors as a floating crystal (break the anchor to get the shard back).
- **Departure Shard:** use it to travel to that anchor, from any dimension, but never into or out of the Forgotten Land.
Give one half to a friend. Both shards are mended with ender pearls.
almanac.lacuna.fractured_pearl.where: Crafted: an ender pearl among 4 rubies and 4 divine glass shards (DRD / RPR / DRD). The Last Merchant sells them for 10 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.text: It has eaten the light of many graves: 11 damage, slow and heavy. Stand still and hold use to gather a charge; release after a second to send a **crescent wave** 8 blocks ahead (16 to 22 damage, knockback). Moving breaks the charge. Mend it with Umbral Steel ingots.
almanac.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.where: The Wither 20% (+Looting) · Mirror Hoards 8% · ruin caches 0.4% · the Last Merchant, 64 rubies + 2 ruby blocks.
almanac.lacuna.guilds.text:
Three guilds, one oath each: the **Smiths'**, the **Gemcutters'** and the **Scholars'**. Join at a Guild Board for 20 coins once you are a friend of the village (reputation 10+).
Members trade with their guild's **Guildmaster** (Smiths: Umbral Steel and repair kits; Gemcutters: rubies, divine glass and zenithite; Scholars: chronal shards, echo shards and enchanted books) and take **contracts**: deliver the goods for coins and +3 reputation, up to three contracts a day.
almanac.lacuna.guilds.where: Guild boards hang in the guild hall. Crafted: sticks and paper around a gray (Smiths), red (Gemcutters) or purple (Scholars) banner.
almanac.lacuna.heartwood_bow.text: Its arrows grow roots. Whatever they hit is **Rooted** in place for 2 seconds (4 when pinned against a wall), and Grasping Roots sprout around the target or where the arrow lands, holding anything that walks in. Mend it with Echo Birch planks.
almanac.lacuna.heartwood_bow.where: Pillager outposts 7% · woodland mansions 7% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 40 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.inverted_falls.text: Stone islands float 110 to 150 blocks up, veined with **zenithite** and crowned with Crystal Willows and divine glass. Here the waterfalls run upward: an **Updraft Spring** lifts whatever stands in its column, up to 40 blocks, and a chain of springs beside every island carries you to its top.
almanac.lacuna.inverted_falls.where: The warm, humid stretches of the Forgotten Land. Updraft Springs need Silk Touch; placed by hand they lift 40 blocks.
almanac.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence.text:
What is left when the world forgets: the exact shape of the gap. Legendary and always glinting, it is the **only way to make a totem**: the Totem of Banishing, the Totem of Confusion, even a Totem of Undying.
Dropped, it shrugs off fire, lava and explosions and waits twenty minutes.
almanac.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence.wher: A defeated Reflection, always (once per labyrinth) · natural falling stars 20% · Sunken Bell Towers 12% · Prime Star Rock 1% (without Silk Touch) · ruin caches 1% · the Last Merchant, one visit in 5, for 64 rubies + 4 ruby blocks.
almanac.lacuna.lantern_moth.text: A small, glowing moth that flutters around bright light: a lamp, a torch or a player holding one (the Null Lantern does not count). Harmless; when it dies it leaves Silk Dust.
almanac.lacuna.lantern_moth.where: Forests and swamps at night under the open sky, and the Whispering Marsh.
almanac.lacuna.last_merchant.text:
He remembers every price but his own. He deals **only in rubies**: he buys the ores you mined most since his last visit (that is how ore turns into rubies), sells shards, ingots, ember and Fractured Pearls, brings **two random relics**, forges Sun's Fury from a Solar Flare and, one visit in five, sells a Lacunar Quintessence.
Kill him near a village and its prices rise.
almanac.lacuna.last_merchant.where: Near a player in the Overworld, by day: an attempt every 3 days at 25%, about one visit in 12 days. He stays three days.
almanac.lacuna.laws.text:
Each village keeps two of four laws:
- No drawn weapons inside the village.
- Curfew: strangers indoors after dusk (friends of the village may walk).
- No breaking blocks inside the village.
- The bell rings only at dawn.
A warning comes first; then every few seconds of law-breaking costs reputation, and a guard walks over. Every village likes its bell rung at dawn, but not more than three times a day.
almanac.lacuna.laws.where: The Laws tab of the Village Ledger names this village's two laws.
almanac.lacuna.memory_murals.text: Five paintings of the city as it was, in warm colours the land has lost: Dawn over the Spires, The Bright Spire, Harvest Day, Festival of Lanterns and The Fall.
almanac.lacuna.memory_murals.where: On the walls of memory shrines and ruined halls. A painting you hang yourself may turn out to be one of them.
almanac.lacuna.mending.text:
Relics and gadgets wear out with use. Mend them at an anvil with their own material, never by combining two: Umbral Steel for the Eclipser, the Gravemaw, the Null Lantern and the Pocket Watch; divine glass shards for the Magnifying Glass and the Mirror; Echo Fragments for the flute, Ember for the triangle, Star Fragments for the trumpet, Silk Dust for the wand, ender pearls for the pearl shards.
A **Repair Kit** restores a quarter of any item held in the other hand.
**Totems** are the exception: their uses are final, and nothing mends them.
almanac.lacuna.mending.where: Each relic's page in this Almanac names its material. Repair Kits: crafted, or from the Smiths' Guild.
almanac.lacuna.mirror_labyrinth.text:
A 25×25 maze of unbreakable mirror glass. Find the ring at its heart and step on it: your **Reflection** wakes and walks your own path three seconds behind you.
Defeat it and the seals melt away: the exit opens, and so does the **Mirror Hoard**, which always holds a relic (and 10% of the time a Solar Flare Fragment). The Reflection leaves a Lacunar Quintessence. A labyrinth is solved only once.
almanac.lacuna.mirror_labyrinth.where: Rare, in every region of the Forgotten Land; the way in faces south.
almanac.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.text: Every reflection remembers the last one. Raise it like a shield: arrows, tridents, fireballs and bullets coming from the front fly back to whoever shot them, and the mirror keeps an **echo** of each, up to three. Sneak + use fires the oldest echo again, a little weaker every time; after three reuses it shatters. Mend it with divine glass shards.
almanac.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.where: Mirror Hoards 14% · End city treasure 8% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 40 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.null_lantern.text:
It shines a light nobody can see by. Held, hostile mobs ignore you and cannot hurt you; placed and lit, it shelters every player within 12 blocks, and no monster spawns within 24. Bosses pay it no heed.
Its durability is a **charge** that burns slowly (about 50 minutes), held or placed; at zero it only goes dark. Click an Ender Pearl (+50%) or an Echo Shard (+100%) onto it, or use one on the placed lantern.
almanac.lacuna.null_lantern.where: Mirror Hoards 8% · ancient city chests 6% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 48 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.obelisk.text: A black pillar carved with names that move when you look away. Right-click an inscription to read one of its lines. Now and then (12%) something falls from a crack: rubies, divine glass shards or a chronal shard, once per player and obelisk.
almanac.lacuna.obelisk.where: Rare, in the Overworld's forests, taigas, savannas, jungles, badlands, hills, plains, deserts and snowy plains; broken ones stand among the Forgotten Land's ruins.
almanac.lacuna.path.text:
- **The Overworld:** mine rubies (below Y 16) and Umbral Steel (below Y 0), forge Umbral Steel tools, fell the four new trees, make friends in the villages.
- **Relics are found, never crafted:** watch the night sky for falling stars, dive to Sunken Bell Towers, raid treasure and bosses, save rubies for the Last Merchant.
- **A Lacunar Quintessence** and a Totem of Undying make a Totem of Banishing: the key to the Forgotten Land.
- **The Forgotten Land:** divine glass, zenithite, exilite, ruin caches and the Mirror Labyrinth, whose Reflection always leaves another Quintessence.
almanac.lacuna.path.where: The Lacuna advancement tab follows the same road: every milestone hints at where to look next.
almanac.lacuna.pyrrhic_scepter.text: Victory, at a price. Use it to pay **2 health** for a blazing bolt that homes in on the nearest hostile ahead: 5 damage, up to 15 the more wounded you are, and the target catches fire. It refuses when you have 4 health or less. Mend it with gold ingots.
almanac.lacuna.pyrrhic_scepter.where: Bastion treasure 8% · Piglin Brutes 8% (+Looting) · Mirror Hoards 7% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 40 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.quickening_wand.text:
Lend a heart, and still things wake. Aim at a dropped item, or hold one in your off hand, and use the wand: for **one heart** the item grows little legs and fights beside you for 40 seconds with its own gifts: blades slash, bows shoot, food feeds you, TNT charges in. Then it falls asleep again, exactly as it was.
Up to three at once; sneak + use on one to put it to sleep early. Mend it with Silk Dust.
almanac.lacuna.quickening_wand.where: Mirror Hoards 10% · woodland mansions 8% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 48 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.reflection.text: You, three seconds late. Woken on the ring of a Mirror Labyrinth, it walks exactly the path you walked and hurts whatever it touches (6 damage; 20 health). It vanishes if you leave, die or log out, and the ring waits for you again. Defeat it and it always leaves a **Lacunar Quintessence**.
almanac.lacuna.reflection.where: Only in Mirror Labyrinths, one per labyrinth.
almanac.lacuna.repair_kit.text: Hold a damaged item in your other hand and use the kit: it restores a quarter of the item's durability. Totems wear out for good and refuse it.
almanac.lacuna.repair_kit.where: Crafted: 2 Umbral Steel ingots, a Clockwork Gear, 2 leather and an iron ingot (UGU / LIL). The Smiths' Guild sells them too.
almanac.lacuna.reputation.text:
From -100 to 100 in each village: Hostile, Wary, Neutral, Friendly (10+) and Honored (50+). Each point is 0.25% off (or on) your villager prices.
- **Raises it:** trading (+1, twice a day), slaying monsters in the village (+3), ringing its bell at dawn (+2), guild contracts (+3), paying fines.
- **Lowers it:** hurting (-10) or killing (-20) a villager, breaking protected blocks, opening the villagers' containers or harvesting their crops (both free once Honored), breaking the laws.
Hostile visitors are attacked by the village's golems.
almanac.lacuna.reputation.where: On the Village Ledger and every civic screen; each change flashes above your hotbar.
almanac.lacuna.ruby.text: A gem the mountains cried, and the coin of everything forgotten: the Last Merchant takes nothing else. Rubies also grip every Umbral Steel tool, frame Forgotten Portals and go into this Almanac, the Wayfarer's Chart, the Fractured Pearl and the Totem of Banishing. Nine make a Block of Ruby.
almanac.lacuna.ruby.where: Ruby ore deep underground (Y -64 to 16, like diamonds; iron pickaxe, Fortune helps). The Last Merchant pays rubies for the ores you mine; Gemcutters, obelisks, ruin caches, bell towers, hoards and mints have some too.
almanac.lacuna.ruins.text:
Broken arches, fallen colonnades, ruined halls, sunken plazas, memory shrines and obelisk stumps: what is left of a city nobody remembers. Ruin stone cannot be mined, blasted or pushed.
Ruined halls, sunken plazas and memory shrines hide **ruin caches**: rubies, gold, divine glass, now and then a chronal or exilite shard or a Solar Flare Fragment, and one rare roll: a Lacunar Quintessence (1%) or a relic.
almanac.lacuna.ruins.where: All over the Forgotten Land, thickest in the Forgotten Plains.
almanac.lacuna.schools.text: Villagers learn. Every dawn, working villagers within 24 blocks of a School Desk or a lectern gain a lesson's experience, up to the third level; the rest they learn by trading.
almanac.lacuna.schools.where: In the schoolhouse. School Desk: 3 wooden slabs over a book between two sticks (SSS / /B/).
almanac.lacuna.shadow_walk.text:
While shadow walking you are a shade: you pass through walls, unseen, and monsters lose track of you.
Click a creature (or, with PvP on, a player) within 8 blocks to **possess** it: you see through its eyes and steer it with your keys; attacking makes it strike, creepers ignite, ghasts and blazes shoot. Hosts fight back, the hostile, big and wounded ones harder: once their bar fills you have a few seconds left. Sneak to leave; after 30 seconds every host fights back.
Bosses, other players' pets and mummies refuse you.
almanac.lacuna.shadow_walk.where: The Eclipser's dash ends in a Shadow Walk.
almanac.lacuna.silk_dust.text: Right-click a surface to leave a soft glowing mark (light 9) that fades after three minutes. It also mends the Wand of Quickening.
almanac.lacuna.solar_flare.text: Four fragments of a lost noon, made whole around a block of Divine Glass. On its own a Solar Flare does nothing: the Last Merchant sets it into **Sun's Fury** for 32 rubies, at every visit.
almanac.lacuna.solar_flare.where: Crafted: 4 Solar Flare Fragments around Divine Glass. Fragments: Mirror Hoards 10%, Molten Star Rock 3%, ruin caches 1.5%, and the Last Merchant in 8% of his visits (16 rubies and 8 divine glass shards).
almanac.lacuna.star_rock.text:
A fallen star leaves a block that cools in three stages; Silk Touch keeps each one.
- **Molten Star Rock:** burns to stand on; water or rain cool it at once, or it takes a minute or two. Mined: 1-2 Star Fragments, 3% a Solar Flare Fragment.
- **Prime Star Rock:** glitters and chimes at night. Mined: 1-3 fragments (+Fortune) and, 1% of the time without Silk Touch, a Lacunar Quintessence. It burns out after about three days.
- **Extinguished:** grey moon rock, at most one fragment.
Star Fragments mend the Starcaller Trumpet and weave Starlace Cloth.
almanac.lacuna.star_rock.where: Wherever a star fell: natural falling stars on clear nights, or the ones you call with the Starcaller Trumpet.
almanac.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.text:
Sound it, and a star answers. A small falling star streaks down where you look, up to 96 blocks away, or **locks on** to the creature under your crosshair and follows it down. The impact deals up to 8 damage with knockback and fire, and leaves a **Molten Star Rock** to mine; it cracks the ground only with mob griefing on.
32 uses, 30 s cooldown; mend it with Star Fragments.
almanac.lacuna.starcaller_trumpet.where: Sunken Bell Towers 5% · pillager outposts 5% · the Last Merchant, 40 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.starlace_armor.text:
Zenithite thread that still remembers the night sky: as sturdy as iron, with powers that grow with the pieces you wear.
- **Starlit:** +5% speed per piece at night under the open sky, or in the End.
- **Starfall:** two pieces halve fall damage; the full set turns a fall of over 5 blocks into a starlight shockwave that strikes foes nearby.
- **Constellation Step** (full set): jump again in mid-air.
- **Boots:** sneak while falling to glide on starlight.
almanac.lacuna.starlace_armor.where: Crafted in the vanilla armour shapes from Starlace Cloth (24 for the set): 1 zenithite shard and 2 string give 2 cloth; 1 Star Fragment and 3 string give 4.
almanac.lacuna.starlace_bandage.text:
Strips of starlace: what they bind lies still and silent. Use bandages on a creature to wrap it into a **mummy**: one for peaceful creatures, two for hostile or large ones, three for large hostile ones. A mummy cannot move, attack or make a sound, never despawns and takes less damage. Shears unwrap it exactly as it was, and some bandages come back.
Players, bosses and other people's pets refuse.
almanac.lacuna.starlace_bandage.where: Crafted: 3 Starlace Cloth and 1 string give 3 bandages.
almanac.lacuna.sunken_bell_tower.text:
A drowned tower rising from the ocean floor. Its base chest holds prismarine, metals, rubies, divine glass and one rare roll: a Lacunar Quintessence (12%) or a relic.
At the top hangs the **Sunken Bell**: ring it and the nearest ores within 24 blocks glow through the stone for 8 seconds (once a minute).
almanac.lacuna.sunken_bell_tower.where: Oceans and deep oceans of the Overworld. The bell drops itself and rings wherever you hang it.
almanac.lacuna.suns_fury.text:
A noon that was never allowed to end. Hold use to draw it back, release to throw: it is **used up**. Where it lands the sun climbs to midday, then a column of light burns everything within 7 blocks for three seconds and, with mob griefing on, carves the ground away. In the Overworld it leaves the sky clear at noon.
In the Forgotten Land it fizzles, and you keep it.
almanac.lacuna.suns_fury.where: Mirror Hoards 4% · Sunken Bell Towers 2% · the Last Merchant forges one from a Solar Flare for 32 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.tidebloom.text: A red and teal mangrove standing on tangled roots. Tidebloom Roots splash when broken, and now and then a fish appears in the water beside them. A complete wood family.
almanac.lacuna.tidebloom.where: Swamps, mangrove swamps and rivers; the Whispering Marsh.
almanac.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.text:
It remembers every tide that ever turned. Use it to roll a **Tidal Wave** 14 blocks ahead: it sweeps foes along (4 damage), puts out fire and crusts lava over.
Hits in water or rain, waves that land and time spent in water build up to three **Tide Charges**; with all three, sneak + use opens a **Maelstrom** that drowns what it drags in and ends in a geyser. Melee hits drench and strike harder in water or rain. Mend it with prismarine shards.
almanac.lacuna.tidecaller_sickle.where: Elder Guardians 33% (+Looting) · Sunken Bell Towers 6% · the Last Merchant, 48 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.text:
A stone hand that remembers a land no one else does.
- **Use:** cross to the Forgotten Land in a blast that throws everything nearby back, at both ends; used there, it brings you home early.
- **Strike** a creature (or a player, with PvP): it is hurled away and banished. Bosses resist.
- **Use on a ring of Forgotten Portal Frames** to light the portal.
Six uses in all, never mended: every crossing, banishment and portal counts.
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.where: Crafted: a Lacunar Quintessence above a Totem of Undying, with 3 rubies and 2 gold ingots (RQR / GTG / .R.).
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.text:
Five of you. Only one is real. Use it and five copies of you appear around you, with your skin, armour and held items. Three times in four you **swap places** with one of them, and only you are told. The copies mirror your every move, each on its own heading, and the hostile mobs hunting you are drawn to them.
Two hits break a copy; they all fade after 20 seconds. Three uses, 45 s cooldown.
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_confusion.where: Crafted: an ender pearl, 2 amethyst shards, an armour stand, 2 gold ingots and a Lacunar Quintessence (.P. / AMA / GQG).
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_undying.text: The vanilla totem that cheats death, now also crafted the legendary way: a Lacunar Quintessence set in gold, with two emeralds for eyes. It is the heart of every Totem of Banishing.
almanac.lacuna.totem_of_undying.where: Evokers (woodland mansions and raids), or crafted: 2 emeralds, 4 gold ingots and a Lacunar Quintessence (EGE / GQG / .G.).
almanac.lacuna.treasure.text:
Some relics went where the old powers sleep, or lie in treasure that suits them:
- **The Wither:** Gravemaw Greatsword 20%
- **Elder Guardians:** Tidecaller Sickle 33%
- **The Warden:** Echo Dagger 33%
- **Piglin Brutes:** Pyrrhic Scepter 8%
- **Ancient city chests:** Null Lantern 6%, Whisperbone Flute 6%, Echo Dagger 4%, Eclipser 2%
- **Bastion treasure:** Ember Triangle 12%, Pyrrhic Scepter 8%
- **Pillager outposts:** Heartwood Bow 7%, Starcaller Trumpet 5%
- **Woodland mansions:** Wand of Quickening 8%, Heartwood Bow 7%
- **Desert pyramids:** Divine Magnifying Glass 8%
- **End city treasure:** Mirror of Recursion 8%
almanac.lacuna.treasure.where: Boss chances need a player kill; Looting adds 1% per level. The chest chances are per chest.
almanac.lacuna.ui.tagline: What the world forgot, and where to find it.
almanac.lacuna.umbral_steel.text: A dark, violet-veined steel that grows heavier in the dark. Smelt or blast the raw steel into ingots; nine nuggets make an ingot, nine ingots a block. It makes Umbral Steel tools and Repair Kits, and mends the Eclipser, the Gravemaw Greatsword, the Null Lantern and the Pocket Watch.
almanac.lacuna.umbral_steel.where: Umbral Steel ore below Y 0 in the Overworld (iron pickaxe). Spiders and cave spiders drop a nugget 5% of the time (player kills, +Looting). Ingots: the Last Merchant (4 rubies) and the Smiths' Guild.
almanac.lacuna.umbral_steel_tools.text:
Steel that grows heavier in the dark: netherite-level mining, 1500 uses, and every tool sets a ruby in its grip.
- **Nightforged:** they all dig 30% faster where the light is 7 or less.
- In the dark (light 4 or less) they hit 25% harder.
- **Sword, Umbral Rend:** every third hit on the same foe tears it open: +6 armour-piercing damage, heals you, slows and blinds it.
- **Axe, Eclipse Cleave:** fully charged hits send a shockwave dealing 60% of the hit to foes within 3 blocks.
almanac.lacuna.umbral_steel_tools.where: Crafted in the vanilla shapes from Umbral Steel ingots, with a ruby in place of the first stick.
almanac.lacuna.village_coin.text:
Every village mints its own coin. The **Coiner**, a villager who works at a Mint Press, turns raw ore and ingots into coins; coins pay fines, guild fees and the trades of the Magistrate and the Guildmasters.
The coin floats between 0.60 and 1.40: every 16 ore minted weakens it by 2%, and it recovers a little each day. A strong coin buys more.
almanac.lacuna.village_coin.where: Coiners' trades, mint strongboxes and guild contracts. Mint Press: 3 iron ingots, a piston and 3 smooth stone (III / .P. / SSS).
almanac.lacuna.village_ledger.text: The village's memory. Right-click it for its screen: your standing and prices, the laws, the council and today's record of what you did. Placed outside every village, it **founds** a village of its own around itself, and the villagers there start living by the civic rules.
almanac.lacuna.village_ledger.where: In every village hall. Crafted (shapeless): a lectern, a book and quill and an emerald.
almanac.lacuna.wayfarers_chart.text:
Wherever you wander, it remembers the Overworld. Hold it like a map: a live chart of the Overworld around you that scrolls as you walk, with markers for the world spawn, your bed and where your banishment began. From the Nether or the Forgotten Land it shows the Overworld under your **translated position** (×8, ×12).
Land seen lately is inked in full colour; the rest is sketched faintly. Sneak + use to change the scale, from 1 to 16 blocks per pixel.
almanac.lacuna.wayfarers_chart.where: Crafted: a Divine Glass Shard over an empty map between 2 rubies, above a compass (.D. / RMR / .C.).
almanac.lacuna.welcome.text:
Lacuna fills the gaps the world forgot: a grey land you only reach by banishment, relics no smith can forge, villages that keep laws and coins.
Every page tells what a thing does and, in the gold-rimmed box, **where to find it**. Turn pages with the arrows, the arrow keys or the mouse wheel. The tabs on the right open a chapter; the top one, or Home, brings you back to the contents.
Hover an icon to see its tooltip. Over any Lacuna item, hold **Shift** (Controls → Lacuna) for its details: relics even say where they turn up.
almanac.lacuna.welcome.where: Every player is handed one on first joining a world. Lost it? A book and a ruby make another.
almanac.lacuna.whisperbone_flute.text: The dead still know the tune. Play it to call back up to three **Echoes** of creatures that died within 20 blocks in the last minute. They fight beside you for 10 seconds, then fade, each leaving an Echo Fragment, which mends the flute at an anvil. 60 s cooldown.
almanac.lacuna.whisperbone_flute.where: Mirror Hoards 6% · ancient city chests 6% · Sunken Bell Towers 4% · ruin caches 0.5% · the Last Merchant, 32 rubies.
almanac.lacuna.whispering_marsh.text: Shallow pools, mud and Tidebloom mangroves under a fog so thick that distant sounds come muffled. **Spore Mushrooms** glow and make every creature within 6 blocks shine through the mist. Lantern Moths drift here, and spiders lurk.
almanac.lacuna.whispering_marsh.where: The humid stretches of the Forgotten Land. Spore Mushrooms drop themselves.
almanac.lacuna.zenithite.text: A sky-blue crystal found only where waterfalls run upward. Spun with string it becomes Starlace Cloth, and it mends the Echo Dagger. Nine shards make a Block of Zenithite.
almanac.lacuna.zenithite.where: Zenithite ore on the floating islands of the Inverted Falls (1-2 shards, +Fortune). The Last Merchant sells 2 for 3 rubies; the Gemcutters' Guild, one for 6 coins.
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use: Use a Chronal Shard: +%s s of sand, up to %s min (sneak: pour in the whole stack)
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use2: While the sand runs, time within %2$s blocks flows %1$sx faster: furnaces, crops, grass, saplings, ice melting, copper aging, young animals, eggs
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use3: A redstone signal holds the sand; comparators read the time left
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use4: Water and lava flow %1$sx faster; players heal %2$sx faster and shake off harmful effects sooner
block.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.use5: Redstone timing, spawners, portals and other hourglasses are never affected

effect.lacuna.shadow_walk.description: A shadow that passes through walls, unseen. Click a creature or player to possess it until it casts you out.
item.lacuna.almanac.lore: Everything the world forgot, written down before it is gone.
item.lacuna.almanac.tip: The tabs on its fore-edge open the chapters; Home goes back to the contents.
item.lacuna.almanac.use: Use: open it. What everything does, and where to find it.
item.lacuna.arrival_shard.lore: The right half. It wants to stay.
item.lacuna.arrival_shard.use: Use: throw; it anchors where it lands.
item.lacuna.ashen_snow_block.tip: Every step leaves a dark footprint that slowly fades.
item.lacuna.buried_watch.tip: Dig it up: chronal shards spill out.
item.lacuna.chiseled_exilite.tip: The totem's open hand, carved into its own stone; a pearl glints where the ruby was.
item.lacuna.chrono_hourglass.tip: Every grain is a borrowed second.
item.lacuna.chronoshard_pocket_watch.lor: It ticks a little behind the world.
item.lacuna.chronoshard_pocket_watch.tip: Relic, never crafted: Sunken Bell Towers, village mints, Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.clear_ice.tip: So clear you barely see it.
item.lacuna.clockwork_decoy.tip: Throw it: monsters chase the mannequin for 15 s.
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.tip: One thing at a time. It's large, not infinite.
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use: Empty: use on a creature, a cart or a boat to stuff it inside
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use2: Empty: sneak + use on a block to bag it, contents and all
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use3: Full: use on a block face to let it out, exactly as it went in
item.lacuna.comically_large_bag.use4: Empty: use on a player to carry them off for a while (PvP only)
item.lacuna.council_table.tip: The village council meets here every seven days.
item.lacuna.crystal_willow_shard.tip: Fallen from crystal willow leaves. Four make a block of glass.
item.lacuna.departure_shard.lore: The left half. It wants to go back.
item.lacuna.departure_shard.use: Use: travel to the linked anchor, from any dimension (never into or out of the Forgotten Land).
item.lacuna.divine_glass.tip: Look through it from close by: ores, chests, spawners and creatures behind it show.
item.lacuna.divine_glass_cluster.tip: Mine it for Divine Glass Shards.
item.lacuna.divine_glass_pane.tip: Look through it from close by: what hides behind it shows.
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.lore: Sunlight remembers where it was told to go.
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.tip: Relic, never crafted: desert pyramids, village mints, Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.use: Hold use: focus a burning beam of light.
item.lacuna.echo_birch_sapling.tip: Two saplings three blocks apart grow a bridge of leaves between them.
item.lacuna.echo_dagger.tip: Relic, never crafted: Wardens, ancient cities, Mirror hoards, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.echo_fragment.tip: A memory that refused to fade.
item.lacuna.eclipser.dash: Dash: %s to %s damage to every foe in its path; the air wake hurls them aside
item.lacuna.eclipser.lore: Where it cuts, the light forgets to return.
item.lacuna.eclipser.tip: Relic, never crafted: Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, ancient cities, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.ember.tip: Burns for a very long time.
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.lore: Three embers that swore never to go out.
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.pvp: Other players only when PvP is on
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.repair: Repair at an anvil with Ember (+%s uses each)
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.spare: Spares you, your pets, villagers, golems and peaceful animals
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.tip: Relic, never crafted: bastion treasure, Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.use: Use: Thermal Wave (%s blocks around you)
item.lacuna.ember_triangle.use_detail: Hostile creatures and anything hunting you are pulverized on the spot
item.lacuna.exilite.tip: Calcite stained by a single shard. Polish it, cut it into bricks, carve the hand into it.
item.lacuna.exilite_block.tip: Nine Exilite Ingots, pressed together. A beacon base; never burns.
item.lacuna.exilite_debris.tip: The buried remains of the stone the Totem of Banishing was carved from. Hidden deep in the Forgotten Land, never in the open, and rarely. Needs a diamond pickaxe; no explosion breaks it. Smelt it for a shard.
item.lacuna.exilite_ingot.tip: Between two crying obsidian: two Forgotten Portal Frames, no rubies needed. Nine: a Block of Exilite. Never burns.
item.lacuna.exilite_shard.tip: Smelted from Exilite Debris. Four shards and four gold ingots: an Exilite Ingot. One in a ring of calcite: eight blocks of Exilite.
item.lacuna.extinguished_star_rock.tip: A spent star, grey and cratered like the Moon. Mined, it gives at most one Star Fragment.
item.lacuna.forgotten_portal_frame.tip: Eight frames, two per side with the corners empty, around a 2×2 opening: touch one with the Totem of Banishing.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.lore: Two halves that never stopped looking for each other.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.use: Use: split into an Arrival and a Departure shard.
item.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.lore: It has eaten the light of many graves.
item.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.tip: Relic, never crafted: the Wither, Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.gravemaw_greatsword.use: Stand still and hold use: release a crescent wave
item.lacuna.guild_board.tip: Join a guild or take a contract.
item.lacuna.heartwood_bow.tip: Relic, never crafted: pillager outposts, woodland mansions, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.heartwood_bow.use: Arrows sprout grasping roots that hold whatever they catch
item.lacuna.heartwood_bow.use2: Hit targets are rooted (longer against a wall)
item.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence.lore: What is left when the world forgets: the exact shape of the gap.
item.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence.tip: Found where the world forgets: a defeated Reflection, a star nobody called, the deepest chests, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.lacunar_quintessence.use: Every totem is made from it: the Totems of Banishing, Confusion and Undying
item.lacuna.mirror_glass.tip: It reflects whoever stands before it.
item.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.lore: Every reflection remembers the last one.
item.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.tip: Relic, never crafted: Mirror hoards, End cities, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.mirror_of_recursion.use: Hold: reflect projectiles. Sneak + use: release a stored echo.
item.lacuna.molten_star_rock.tip: Fresh from the sky: burns to stand on and cools to Prime Star Rock in a minute or two, at once in water or rain. Mined now: only 1-2 Star Fragments, rarely a Solar Flare Fragment.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.lore: It shines a light nobody can see by.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.recharge: Recharge: click an Ender Pearl (+50%%) or an Echo Shard (+100%%) onto it, or use one on the placed lantern.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.tip: Relic, never crafted: ancient cities, Mirror hoards, Forgotten ruins, the Last Merchant.
item.lacuna.null_lantern.use: Held or placed: hostile mobs ignore you and cannot hurt you (placed: anyone within 12 blocks).
item.lacuna.obelisk_inscription.tip: The names move when you look away.
item.lacuna.prime_star_rock.tip: The star at its best: mine it with a pickaxe for 1-3 Star Fragments (Fortune helps) and, very rarely, a Lacunar Quintessence. It chimes softly, and burns out after about three days.

lacuna.obelisk.line.0: Here the names were carved so deep that the stone forgot them.
lacuna.obelisk.line.1: We built the city of glass, and the city remembered us instead.
lacuna.obelisk.line.10: We traded our past for a quiet land. The land kept both.
lacuna.obelisk.line.11: The rubies were tears of the mountain. We made crowns of them.
lacuna.obelisk.line.12: Ash falls where snow once did; it remembers footsteps a little longer.
lacuna.obelisk.line.13: The waterfalls turned upward the day the river lost its name.
lacuna.obelisk.line.14: Every festival ended with a song no one could finish.
lacuna.obelisk.line.15: If you hear whispering in the marsh, answer politely.
lacuna.obelisk.line.16: The merchant who still walks remembers every price but his own.
lacuna.obelisk.line.17: Here stood the library. The books are still here; the words left.
lacuna.obelisk.line.18: Eclipse was not the end. It was a door left ajar.
lacuna.obelisk.line.19: Mark the place where you stand: one day it will forget you too.
lacuna.obelisk.line.2: Count the towers. Then count the people. One number is missing.
lacuna.obelisk.line.20: Seven brothers, one obelisk, no names.
lacuna.obelisk.line.21: The glass grows where the light was kindest.
lacuna.obelisk.line.22: The hounds of brass still follow a master who never returns.
lacuna.obelisk.line.23: Read slowly. The letters move when you are not looking.
lacuna.obelisk.line.3: The sun was ours for a thousand summers.
lacuna.obelisk.line.4: Whoever reads this has already forgotten who wrote it.
lacuna.obelisk.line.5: The bells rang under the sea so the drowned would not feel alone.
lacuna.obelisk.line.6: Twelve steps there are one step here.
lacuna.obelisk.line.7: A name is a door. We closed all of ours.
lacuna.obelisk.line.8: The watches still tick in the sand, counting for no one.
lacuna.obelisk.line.9: Do not look for us in the mirrors. Only you live there now.
